Counterexamples to Hypotheses 2, 3 and 4 and to both halves of Question 2 of Adaricheva, Mata,
Silberger and Zamojska-Dzienio (DMTCS 28:2 (2026), doi:10.46298/dmtcs.16374). Hypothesis 2 already
fails for a convex geometry of convex dimension three on six points (25 closed sets), so their
theorem for convex dimension two does not extend; a convex geometry on five points with 17 closed
sets is the smallest counterexample on five points. Hypothesis 1 remains open.

Attached: the paper (PDF), its LaTeX source with the figures as PNG, and the arXiv tarball. The
repository contains the Lean 4 proofs with Mathlib (twenty theorems, standard axioms only), the C and
Python checks, and the dated priority check.

Author: Deep Bhattacharjee (ORCID 0000-0003-0466-750X).
